mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 44 degrees with clear skies at Harriet Park, and we are currently seeing a third quarter moon.

Mayor Diaz has declared October as Community Planning Month, honoring the Planning and Development Department for their work. Also, the Senior Center is now offering free rides on their three-wheeled tri-shaw bikes along the Military Ridge State Trail.

Today, you can visit the Dane County Farmers Market at the Capitol or catch live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, the World Dairy Expo and the Farley Center Fall Festival are both happening tomorrow.
On Sunday, September 21, officers identified and cited an individual for retail theft after they were caught on surveillance video taking Swedish Fish from a local business.
The flavor of the day is the delicious Really Reese's, and you can head over to Culver's when they open today at 10:00 AM.
